objective: Find and validate a general V8 compiler improvement visible in unchanged official V8 benchmarks.
acceptance: Inspect current upstream V8 and profile unchanged official benchmark workloads before selecting a patch.
No station-name, 1BRC, benchmark-name, fixed-input, or workload-specific runtime behavior.
Demonstrate the general code-generation deficiency with native instructions and the compiler IR/source responsible.
Add semantic and compiler regression coverage, including edge cases and deoptimization/trapping behavior.
Build baseline and candidate with identical tools/options; use unchanged official benchmark sources with paired fresh processes.
Report exact suites and per-test effects, variance, negative results and any build/test limits; do not claim an overall V8 gain from a single microbenchmark.
Keep the production plain Node and Wasm solvers on the previously selected stock runtime.
Checkpoint every experiment with unsigned commits; prepare local reviewable patches and results, without publishing externally.
initialEvidence: The 1BRC profiles motivate inspecting integer representation, repeated typed-array/DataView checks, and machine-level lowering; official benchmark profiles will determine whether these are relevant beyond this program.
